consoleErrorRootCaused: The headless run logged one console error: 'Failed to start the connection: Error: The connection was stopped during negotiation.' Traced to src/main.tsx wrapping <App /> in <StrictMode>, combined with the connect loop in src/api/combatHub.ts (retry loop awaiting connection.start(), cleanup path awaiting connection.stop()). React StrictMode double-invokes effects in dev (mount, cleanup, remount); the cleanup's connection.stop() can land while the first mount's connection.start() is still negotiating, producing this exact SignalR error text. Dev-only: StrictMode's double-invocation does not happen in a production build. The LIVE badge showed connected in every captured screenshot including the one immediately after, consistent with this being the harmless first-mount attempt rather than a persistent failure. Not changed, since 'fixing' it would mean weakening StrictMode or the connect loop for a dev-only cosmetic console line.
